verdict.rationale: Loops publishes provider-specific migration guides (Brevo, Customer.io) and a migrate page for mapping contacts, lists, templates, and cutover steps, and lets every plan upload unlimited contacts. These guides are developer/agent-oriented (SDK swaps, API mapping), not clearly a guided marketer list-import flow, and nothing shows that tags, custom fields, or unsubscribe state carry over. Missing for 10: a documented guided import UI for marketers, explicit preservation of tags/custom fields, explicit preservation of unsubscribe/suppression state, independent corroboration of migrations.
